record.title: Greek farmer vehicle blockade at Evzoni–Bogorodica, January–February 2017
record.exceptions: Pedestrians reportedly could pass, based on the indexed Yeni Balkan reproduction. Dojran and Medzitlija remained alternatives.
record.enforcement: Tractors obstructed the road; later reports describe their removal and restored vehicle traffic.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Distinct from R7-EUAM-001, the brief January 31 Kulata–Promachonas block on the Bulgaria frontier. Current/pending union has no matching Evzoni January–February 2017 vehicle episode. Shared national protest context is retained, without joining separate frontier traffic intervals.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_corrections: The vehicle blockade is dated January 30–February 17 by onset, intermediate, morning-still-closed and actual restoration reports. Eighteen calendar days is not an elapsed-hour measurement. Several reports share AMSM origin. Pedestrian passage was separately reported and is excluded; no all-person or all-Greece frontier closure is claimed.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained
record.rationale_phase_note: Codes apply only to their stated phase and attribution; no common primary rationale or complete temporal overlap is presumed.
